abilities.d: 受到電屬性的招式攻擊時， 不但不會受到傷害，反而速度會提高。
abilities.de: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

abilities.d: 有時會讓接觸到自己的 對手陷入灼傷狀態。
abilities.de: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

abilities.d: 天氣為冰雹時， 速度會提高。
abilities.de: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

abilities.d: 寶可夢的屬性會隨著 場地的狀態而改變。
abilities.de: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

abilities.d: 只要是接觸到對手的招式， 就可以無視對手的防守效果進行攻擊。
abilities.de: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

abilities.d: 可防住對手的 球和彈類的招式。
abilities.de: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

abilities.d: 奪走被自己招式 擊中的對手的道具。
abilities.de: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

abilities.d: 變為與自己使出的招式 相同的屬性。
abilities.de: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

abilities.d: 有時會撿來對手用過的道具。 冒險過程中也會撿來。
abilities.de: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

abilities.d: 無論是哪種樹果， 吃下去後ＨＰ都會回復。
abilities.de: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

abilities.d: ＨＰ全滿時， 可以搶先在對手之前 使出飛行屬性的招式。
abilities.de: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

abilities.d: 被鱗粉守護著， 不會受到招式的追加效果影響。
abilities.de: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

abilities.d: 因為擁有複眼， 會提高招式的命中率。
abilities.de: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

abilities.d: 可以減少我方受到的傷害。
abilities.de: Reduces damage dealt to allies.
Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

abilities.d: 我方的草屬性寶可夢 能力不會降低。 也不會陷入異常狀態。
abilities.de: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

abilities.d: 同伴使用道具時， 會把自己持有的道具交給同伴。
abilities.de: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

abilities.d: 全體的妖精屬性招式變強。
abilities.de: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

abilities.d: 對手的物理招式造成的 傷害會減半。
abilities.de: Halves the damage from physical moves.

abilities.d: 若使出攻擊招式，會變為刀劍形態， 若使出招式「王者盾牌」， 會變為盾牌形態。
abilities.de: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

abilities.d: 可防住向自己和同伴 發出的心靈攻擊。
abilities.de: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

abilities.d: 我方的寶可夢 不會陷入睡眠狀態。
abilities.de: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

abilities.d: 用吸盤將自己牢牢吸附在地面上， 讓替換寶可夢的招式和道具失效。
abilities.de: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

abilities.d: 對手用攻擊接觸到自己時， 降低此對手的速度。
abilities.de: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

abilities.d: 可多次採收 已被使用過的樹果。
abilities.de: May create another Berry after one is used.

abilities.d: 可以不接觸對手 就使出所有的招式。
abilities.de: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

abilities.d: 所有的聲音招式 都變為水屬性。
abilities.de: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

abilities.d: 透過激發出幹勁， 不會陷入睡眠狀態。
abilities.de: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

abilities.d: 攻擊中毒狀態的對手時， 必定會擊中要害。
abilities.de: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

abilities.d: 受到攻擊時， 防禦會提高。
abilities.de: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

abilities.d: 降低自己受到的火屬性 招式的威力。不會灼傷。
abilities.de: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

abilities.d: 就算對方是鋼屬性或毒屬性寶可夢， 也可讓對方陷入中毒狀態。
abilities.de: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

abilities.d: 向對手施加威懾力， 使其無法對我方使出先制招式。
abilities.de: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

abilities.d: 繼承被打倒的同伴的特性， 變為相同的特性。
abilities.de: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

abilities.d: 能力被降低時， 攻擊會大幅提高。
abilities.de: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

abilities.d: 用畫皮覆蓋住身體， 可防住１次攻擊。
abilities.de: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

abilities.d: ＨＰ因對手的攻擊 降到一半時， 特攻會提高。
abilities.de: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.

abilities.d: 只反彈自己受到的 能力降低效果。
abilities.de: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

abilities.d: 讓樹果成熟， 使效果變為２倍。
abilities.de: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

abilities.d: 自己的攻擊雖會變高， 但命中率會降低。
abilities.de: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

abilities.d: 受到攻擊時， 會刮起沙暴。
abilities.de: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

abilities.d: 出場時，敵方和我方的 光牆、反射壁和極光幕的效果會消失。
abilities.de: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

abilities.d: 與使用接觸類招式 攻擊自己的寶可夢互換特性。
abilities.de: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

abilities.d: 被堅硬的甲殼守護著， 不會被對手的攻擊擊中要害。
abilities.de: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

abilities.d: 在每個回合結束時， 會在滿腹花紋和空腹花紋之間 交替改變樣子。
abilities.de: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

abilities.d: 會將對手所給予的接觸類招式的傷害減半， 但火屬性招式的傷害會變為２倍。
abilities.de: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

abilities.d: 靠著耐熱的體質， 讓火屬性的招式威力減半。
abilities.de: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.
Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

abilities.d: 道具會黏在 具有黏性的身體上， 不會被對手奪走。
abilities.de: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
